Too many men suffer through illness alone.

June is National Men’s Health Month, when we work to break the stigma of seeking help.

And this weekend, the Men’s Health & Wellness Conference is in Las Vegas.

No one should go through illness alone.

#WorldHeartDay is a good time to reflect on what you can do to reduce your risk for cardiovascular disease. 
 
By increasing your physical activity, maintaining a healthy diet, and lessening tobacco use, premature deaths from heart disease and stroke can be reduced by up to 80%. https://t.co/FQ0Yc0xBFK

Adequate nutrition and access to food can change lives.

Let’s come together this #WorldFoodDay and support the mission of leaving no one behind.

“Better production, better nutrition, a better environment, and a better life.”

My office presented the 17 graduates of the Las Vegas Justice Court Veterans Treatment Court with a certificate honoring their achievement.
 
Congratulations to all the graduates and everyone involved for achieving a 94% reduction in recidivism. https://t.co/hNksgoSOLX

I recently met with participants and counselors with Vegas Stronger, a non-profit focused on helping those impacted by the opioid epidemic recover.
 
Programs like these are important. I’ll continue to advocate for more substance treatment and mental health services in Congress. https://t.co/lmC6hZszfQ

Russia’s detention of Brittany Griner and her move to a remote penal colony is wrong.
 
We must not forget her and her unjustified treatment and work to bring her home.

The North Las Vegas Police Department serves our communities but their job can be taxing.

I secured a $145,000 investment for the @NLVPD Officer Wellness project to promote their physical and mental health and ensure they can continue to keep us safe. https://t.co/EFYbgDNogy

Anyone can be affected by cancer. 

It’s critical that we #CloseTheCareGap and ensure that everyone has access to cancer education, prevention, treatment, and care regardless of where you live, your income, your ethnicity, or your gender. https://t.co/TmNye4to71

The #PROAct is the most significant update to labor laws in 80 years and will:

✅ Empower workers to exercise their right to organize
✅ Hold employers accountable for labor law violations
✅ Allow unions to hold free, fair, and safe elections https://t.co/f0Ds14Ah3z

Join me in taking the time this week to thank the many public health professionals in Nevada & across the country for their dedication to promoting wellness & improving the health of our communities.

Let’s work together towards a healthier future.

#NationalPublicHealthWeek https://t.co/GRIgXJ4hdX
As we mark #NationalYouthHIVAIDSAwarenessDay, we must recommit to raising awareness about HIV prevention and treatment options among our youth. https://t.co/2bJw9dx4Fl

I was proud to present the $145,000 investment I secured for the @NLVPD Officer Wellness project to promote their physical & mental health & ensure they can continue to keep us safe.

Thanks to this project, our local police officers will be better able to serve our communities. https://t.co/VsmjHSP8uW

Today is National Asian and Pacific Islander HIV/AIDS Awareness Day.

Let's join together to raise awareness of the impact of HIV/AIDS on API communities and promote prevention, testing, treatment, and stigma reduction.

#NAPIHAAD https://t.co/DcLJhzyhbP

Did you know that June is #MensHealthMonth?

Together, we can foster a culture of wellness that inspires men in Nevada and across the country to take proactive steps towards a healthier lifestyle, regular check-ups, and self-care. https://t.co/MdVeaov6kN

Exciting news for #NV04!

I'm happy to announce funding for three projects that will help support Nevada’s youth & prevent & reduce crime:

✅ Gentlemen By Choice: $250k
✅ Clark County Public Defender Counseling: $175k
✅ North Las Vegas Police Officer Wellness Program: $145k https://t.co/z1uSs2H1up

I joined @NevadaHANDLV's Senior Wellness Festival & shared my work to advocate for #NV04 seniors.

I've voted for provisions capping Rx drug costs at $2k/year for Medicare & supported the Social Security 2100 Act to prevent drastic cuts.

I'll keep working for our seniors. https://t.co/YMNIB9L6kN

During #RecoveryMonth, we stand together to work for better mental health and wellness.

Remember that no matter the challenge, #RecoveryIsPossible.

Over 59 million Americans are proof that #RecoveryIsReal.

Learn, support, and spread hope at https://t.co/0IqkEUlOPD https://t.co/n8CeMnQFZZ

After 148 days of standing strong, TV & movie writers are returning to work, marking a triumph for labor rights.

This shows the power of collective voice and the need for fair treatment of employees.

I’ll continue to champion the rights of workers in every industry.

#MentalIllnessAwarenessWeek is a reminder to prioritize our mental well-being and check in with those around us.

Recognize the warning signs, and don’t hesitate to seek help or offer support. Your mental health is important.

Learn more https://t.co/PbURHyMEtJ https://t.co/rLCculztSP

Congratulations to Tribe Sin City on the grand opening of their new location to provide treatment for substance use disorder!

Thank you for your work to help those who need it most. https://t.co/U5N0V0oB19

Congratulations to the Las Vegas Municipal Court Department 6 Veterans Treatment Court Graduates Leonardus Jansen and Esther Bright!

#TeamHorsford was proud to present Certificates of Special Congressional Recognition & challenge coins to mark this occasion. https://t.co/k3r9x1x7S2

Today, on #WorldAIDSDay, we honor those who were lost and reaffirm our commitment to ending the HIV/AIDS epidemic.

It's crucial to enhance access to preventative care, testing, and treatment, especially in communities of color and among LGBTQ+ individuals.

#EndAIDS https://t.co/78AkVNKFvZ

January is #CervicalHealthAwareness Month.

This month, we highlight the importance of cervical health screenings and HPV vaccinations.

Early detection is key to prevention and treatment. https://t.co/9YQHM9CtNF

On #WorldCancerDay, we unite in the fight against cancer, advocating for research, prevention, & accessible treatment for all.

It's a day to honor survivors, remember those we've lost, & support those currently battling.

Together, we can make a difference. https://t.co/rdDm7Wv8e0

Did you know that it's #NationalNutritionMonth?

It's a reminder about the importance of making informed food choices & developing healthy eating & activity habits.

Let's work towards a healthier lifestyle for ourselves and our communities.

Learn more at https://t.co/NRdZhvJKRd https://t.co/KEyplqShbi
